name: Public Beta and General Availability Gate Definition
description: Define the public beta criteria, GA gate requirements, and post-launch reliability review process. Covers beta eligibility criteria, feature completeness checklist, performance SLIs/SLOs, security audit requirements, onboarding flow validation, support readiness, GA release checklist (regression suite pass, load test pass, security audit sign-off, documentation completeness, legal review), and post-GA 30/60/90-day reliability review cadence.
purpose: Ensure the public launch is gated on objective, verifiable criteria across quality, security, performance, and support readiness, with a structured post-launch reliability review program to catch regressions early.
acceptanceCriteria: Public beta criteria document defines eligibility, scope, feature completeness threshold, and opt-in/opt-out UX
GA gate checklist enumerates all required sign-offs: regression suite pass, load test within SLOs, security audit clearance, documentation completeness, legal review, support readiness
Post-launch reliability review process defines 30/60/90-day review cadence with SLI trend analysis, incident retrospection, and remediation tracking
Performance SLIs/SLOs specification defines latency, throughput, error budget, and availability targets for GA
Onboarding flow validation specification defines success criteria for first-run experience from signup to first completed task
